activity_statements.statement: operates a consumer and retail banking business offering checking accounts, savings, credit cards, auto loans, and home mortgages to individuals and families
provides business banking and corporate banking services including commercial lending, treasury management, and capital markets to businesses of all sizes
offers wealth management and investment advisory services to affluent and high-net-worth individuals
delivers digital banking through the PNC Mobile App and Virtual Wallet product, enabling consumers to manage accounts, pay bills, and track spending
has served clients for 160 years, operating physical branch and ATM network alongside digital banking channels

name_reality_gap: PNC's 'Financial Services' label is accurate. The less visible reality is that PNC is one of the top 10 US banks by assets, with a particularly strong corporate treasury and institutional banking business alongside consumer banking — it is not a pure retail bank.
extraction_notes: PNC about page was brief with limited concrete activity detail. Personal banking product page gave clear product list. Corporate banking and institutional details from general knowledge; careers and investor pages were inaccessible. Profile reflects confirmed content with moderate confidence.
